strings.name: Burna Boy
strings.summary: Born Damini Ogulu in Port Harcourt, Burna Boy studied in Nigeria and Britain. His self-described Afro-fusion combines African pop, dancehall, hip-hop and soul. Like to Party brought attention in 2012; African Giant, Twice as Tall and international touring expanded Nigerian music’s reach. He won a Grammy in 2021 and performed at the 2026 World Cup final halftime show.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 13, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: By combining African pop, reggae and hip-hop and reaching audiences through international tours and albums, he expands the global influence of contemporary Nigerian music.

strings.facts.f2.label: Education and beginnings
strings.facts.f2.value: Attended secondary school in Nigeria, then studied media-related courses at Sussex and Oxford Brookes universities in Britain.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Global Music Album Grammy
strings.highlights.h1.text: Twice as Tall won the 2021 Grammy for Best Global Music Album.
strings.highlights.h2.title: International reach of African music
strings.highlights.h2.text: Albums, sporting-event performances and major tours expanded audiences for contemporary Nigerian music.

strings.timeline.t2.text: His eighth studio album brought together different traditions and international collaborators.

strings.timeline.t6.title: Released African Giant

strings.timeline.t7.title: Released Outside
